assets.prompt:
Use case: logo-brand.
Asset type: a single pixel-art application emblem for agent-stardew, an open-source Stardew Valley assistant powered by DeepSeek.
Primary request: fuse the recognizable Stardew Valley pixel CHICKEN motif with DeepSeek's BLUE WHALE motif into one charming, coherent icon. Both identities should be immediately legible.
Design: a plump little chicken facing left, with a small creamy-white chicken head, stepped bright red comb, a yellow triangular beak and one dark square eye. Its large rounded COBALT BLUE body is shaped like DeepSeek's friendly broad whale silhouette, with a pale ivory underbelly and a simple small wing/flipper. The rear rises into a clearly recognizable split blue WHALE TAIL fluke in place of the chicken's tail feathers. Two tiny golden chicken feet peek underneath. The whale body and chicken head form one continuous, balanced creature, not two disconnected logos. Keep the chicken cute and the whale's elegant upward tail clear.
Style: genuine economical 16-bit sprite-like pixel art, a small logical pixel grid with clearly visible square blocks, clean crisp stepped contour, uniform pixel scale, flat limited color clusters, minimal 2-tone shading. DeepSeek-like cobalt #4D6BFE as the primary blue, dark navy outline, cream white, vivid red comb and golden beak/feet. No smooth vector curves, no airbrushing, no 3D, no fine surface texture.
Composition: one centered standalone emblem on a square canvas, entire silhouette visible with generous 16 percent margins. Icon should remain readable at 32-64 pixels. No hat, no robot, no tools, no lettering, no slogan, no enclosing badge, no border, no watermark, no extra objects.
Background: true transparent alpha, not a drawn checkerboard, no cast shadow. Output one square PNG logo concept around 1024x1024.

Use case: stylized-concept.
Asset type: a single transparent-background pixel-art mascot sprite for an open-source desktop assistant that plays a cozy farming game and learns to improve its own tools.
Primary request: design one original, friendly little farming automaton, full body, standing idle and holding a small blue metal watering can.
Character identity: short and sturdy handmade wooden body, warm honey-colored square head with gently stepped pixel corners, two simple dark square eyes, tiny calm smile, small straw hat with one fresh green sprout tucked into its band, moss-green work overalls, dark brown short boots, simple brass joints. Endearing and capable, recognizable at small scale.
Style: authentic handcrafted 16-bit pixel art, deliberately chunky visible square pixels and clean stepped edges, compact color clusters, limited palette, almost no dithering, no anti-aliasing, no painterly strokes, no smooth 3D gradients. Cozy rural game feeling. Palette: deep pine #244B3C, leaf green #78A85A, honey ochre #D5A64B, warm wood #AD7042, water blue #68AFBF, dark outline #263833.
Composition: one character only, centered on a square canvas, full silhouette and watering can entirely visible, about 65% of canvas height, generous transparent margins on all sides. Three-quarter front view facing slightly right. No ground tile or cast shadow. Suitable for a UI empty state or assistant avatar.
Background: genuinely transparent alpha, not a drawn checkerboard, no background color.
Output intent: a clean standalone PNG asset, square around 1024 by 1024. No labels, no lettering, no UI, no border, no watermark. This is original project artwork, not an existing game's named character or a traced sprite.

Use case: stylized-concept.
Asset type: standalone landscape welcome illustration for a desktop farming assistant.
Input image 1 is a character and visual style reference, not an edit target. Generate a NEW illustration.
Scene: a small original countryside farm in clear early morning light. One modest timber farmhouse with a moss-green roof, a fenced vegetable patch with a few seedlings, a narrow path, a small pond, distant tree-covered hills and a blue sky. Show the referenced little wooden farming automaton quietly watering the seedlings. Keep the scene purposeful and uncluttered.
Preserve the mascot identity exactly: honey-colored wooden square head, dark simple eyes, straw hat with green sprout, green overalls, brown boots, blue watering can. Make the character part of the scene, not a giant foreground portrait.
Style: handcrafted 16-bit pixel art matching the reference, crisp chunky square pixel clusters, stepped silhouettes, restrained shading, no blur, no painterly brushwork, no photorealism or 3D. Natural pine greens, honey ochre, warm wood browns and gentle water blue.
Composition: wide landscape around 3:2, complete coherent scene with visual breathing room, foliage frames the outer corners, clear upper sky. It will appear beside onboarding text, so do not render text or UI. The art must also read at approximately 600 pixels wide.
Output: one opaque PNG background illustration. No typography, no logo, no watermark, no panels, no inventory, no game HUD. Original farm composition, not a replica screenshot or a canonical game map.

Use case: stylized-concept.
Asset type: transparent spot illustration for the "improving a capability" state of a farming assistant.
Input image 1 is the exact character and style reference. Generate a new pose and a small workbench scene, preserving this character's identity, materials, hat, sprout, overall colors and pixel-art treatment.
Scene: the same little wooden farming automaton is carefully repairing its blue watering can at one small wooden workbench. One hand steadies the can and the other holds a small practical wrench against its spout fitting. A single green seedling in a little pot sits at the far edge of the bench. Expression: quietly focused and friendly. This illustrates learning by improving useful farming tools.
Composition: square canvas; full character and full bench visible as one compact silhouette, ample empty margins. Three-quarter view. No extra characters, no duplicate limbs, no labels.
Style: chunky handcrafted pixel art like the reference, consistent pixel scale, clean stepped outlines, limited pine-green, honey-ochre, wood-brown and water-blue palette, no smooth gradients or blur.
Background: genuine transparent alpha around character and workbench, no scene, no floor, no checkerboard, no cast shadow.
Output: one standalone PNG asset around 1024x1024. No text, no UI, no border, no watermark.
